SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.JNAL_DT DESC, A.JNAL_TIME DESC, A.JNAL_SEQNO DESC) AS RN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.JNAL_DT, A.DTLS_SEQNO, DECODE(A.JNAL_TYPE, '22', '00', '33', '00', A.JNAL_TYPE) ORDER BY A.JNAL_DT DESC, A.JNAL_TIME DESC, A.JNAL_SEQNO DESC) AS P_RN, A.JNAL_DT, A.JNAL_TIME, A.JNAL_SEQNO, A.OFC_CODE, A.MCN_NO, A.JNAL_TYPE, A.JRNL_PROC_REST, A.DEAL_DATE, A.SCR_NO, (SELECT D.CODE_NM FROM TB_CODE_DTL D WHERE D.CODE_SECT = '01' AND D.CODE = RTRIM(A.SCR_NO)) AS SCR_NM, A.DTLS_SEQNO, A.ACCT_NO, A.ESTB_BANK_CODE, NVL(A.DEAL_AMT, 0) AS DEAL_AMT, A.MDN_TYPE, B.Q_CNT AS CHK_CNT, B.Q_CHK_NO AS CHK_NO, B.Q_CHK_NOS AS CHK_NOS, A.BPR_PROC_STAT, A.FACE_IMG_YN, A.ACPT_IMG_YN, A.CARD_IMG_YN, TRIM(A.BFO_COMT) AS BFO_COMT, TRIM(A.AFT_COMT) AS AFT_COMT FROM TB_JL_JNAL A, (SELECT C.JNAL_DT, C.OFC_CODE, C.MCN_NO, C.JNAL_SEQNO, MIN(C.CHK_NO) AS Q_CHK_NO, COUNT(C.CHK_NO) AS Q_CNT, SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE( XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(TAG, ',' || RPAD(DECODE(RAWTOHEX(SUBSTR(C.CHK_NO, 9, 1)), '00', SUBSTR(C.CHK_NO, 1, 8), C.CHK_NO), 14)) ORDER BY C.JNAL_DT DESC, C.JNAL_SEQNO DESC, C.SEQNO ASC).GETSTRINGVAL(), '<[TAG/]+>', ''), 2) AS Q_CHK_NOS FROM TB_JL_JNAL_CHK C WHERE C.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND C.MCN_NO = CAST(#{mcnNo} AS CHAR(3)) AND C.JNAL_DT BETWEEN CAST(#{fromDate} AS CHAR(8)) AND CAST(#{toDate} AS CHAR(8))
AND C.CHK_NO LIKE '%' || #{schData1} || '%'
GROUP BY C.JNAL_DT, C.OFC_CODE, C.MCN_NO, C.JNAL_SEQNO) B WHERE A.JNAL_DT = B.JNAL_DT(+) AND A.OFC_CODE = B.OFC_CODE(+) AND A.MCN_NO = B.MCN_NO(+) AND A.JNAL_SEQNO = B.JNAL_SEQNO(+) AND A.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND A.MCN_NO = CAST(#{mcnNo} AS CHAR(3)) AND A.JNAL_DT BETWEEN CAST(#{fromDate} AS CHAR(8)) AND CAST(#{toDate} AS CHAR(8)) AND A.JNAL_TIME BETWEEN CAST(#{frTi} AS CHAR(6)) AND CAST(#{toTi} AS CHAR(6))
AND A.JNAL_TYPE = #{jnalType}
AND A.JRNL_PROC_REST = #{jrnlProcRest}
AND A.ACCT_NO LIKE '%' || #{schData1} || '%'
AND B.Q_CNT > 0
AND A.DTLS_SEQNO >= CAST(#{schData1} AS CHAR(4))
AND A.DTLS_SEQNO <= CAST(#{schData2} AS CHAR(4))
ORDER BY RN

SELECT C.SEQNO, C.CHK_NO FROM TB_JL_JNAL_CHK C WHERE C.JNAL_DT = CAST(#{jnalDt} AS CHAR(8)) AND C.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND C.MCN_NO = CAST(#{mcnNo} AS CHAR(3)) AND C.JNAL_SEQNO = CAST(#{jnalSeqno} AS CHAR(6)) ORDER BY C.SEQNO
